content: No, that is not true. The C permit is typically associated with long-term residence in France, not a general EU-wide permit. After five years of continuous residence in France, an EU citizen may be eligible for the "Carte de Résident" (Residence Permit), which includes various categories like "Carte de Résident temporaire" (temporary residence permit) or "Carte de Résident permanent" (permanent residence permit). However, the specific conditions, requirements, and categories can vary depending on the country of residence and individual circumstances. It is essential to consult the relevant immigration laws and regulations of the specific EU country where the individual resides.
